Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Source activities. Join compound_structures on activities.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Join molecule_dictionary on activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno. Filter assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1613918' AND activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL AND activities.standard_relation = '='. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Limit None.
